name: forecast.adjustments

list.description: Read the full current native adjustment set with null date bounds.

purpose: Inspect the full current adjustment set without changing adjustments or aggregating amounts.

fields.name: valueTime
fields.meaning: Native adjustment time; no inferred timezone.

identity_description: Typed native adjustment id, preserving string/integer distinction.
limitations: GET /bankCashForecastAdjustmentQuery.json through the Liquidity PortfolioMgmt entry; tenant GUAPW3SG and JSON-string bankCashForecastAdjustmentQueryVO.
Native startValueDate and endValueDate are always null; no date filtering is introduced. Fixed rowStart offsets and pageSize=1000.
Boolean resultFlag=true and result.dataValue rows with integer result.count are required; an explicit inner failure rejects acquisition.
Full native records and types remain unchanged. No scaling, date conversion or amount aggregation; capture time does not establish observation time.
Default list reads cache; live does not publish; refresh saves the current set. No filters or native detail action.
